findings.statement: 0225 §7 explicitly requires postconfirm/precheckpoint journal recovery and observation reconstruction, with0224 validation and no new body; no SUCCEEDED-step exclusion is written.0224 already allows this conditional durable recovery.

The source stops on SUCCEEDED plus absent/non-COMPLETE saved result without checking recoverability; the frozen regression explicitly expects this stop. Safety is preserved, but the supplied qualified recovery premise cannot be called fully conformant to §7 on that stop alone.

Frozen regression is in-memory/context-version1 and same-harness rerun, not a native PG storage-mode1 fresh-process proof. This distinction may support reconciliation but does not itself prove an authorized recovery mechanism or eliminate the exact regression assertion.

Read and validated reconstruction is not automatically a new body or unsettled dispatch. Preserve settlement and provenance, reject unproved/invalid/legacy data, and stop before model if context remains unavailable. No authorization to mutate settled records or invent approval follows.
